clue.text: Having say French and Italian in college, by good fortune

explanation.surface: Someone at college picked up French and Italian through sheer luck.

explanation.definitionFit: A person commanding several languages, such as French plus Italian, is described by this adjective.

clue.text: Mug's plan to go over grassy plains

clue.text: Run for wherewithal to rescue cat from tree

clue.text: Military man eating a coarse biscuit

clue.text: Steal a march on EU over amount worked out

clue.text: Volunteers seize pen, writing in African language

clue.text: Novel way to identify archaeological find

clue.text: Wrongly indicate element of radioactivity

clue.text: Slow mover holding something up badly when making turn in miniature race
